summary.en: A pure ConvNet modernized with transformer-era design and training choices
summary.zh: 以 Transformer 时代的设计与训练方案现代化纯卷积网络

description.en:
ConvNeXt revisited a standard ResNet after vision transformers had become leading visual backbones. The authors progressively introduced a modern training recipe, transformer-inspired stage design, depthwise convolution, inverted bottlenecks, larger kernels, LayerNorm and GELU while keeping the network entirely convolutional.

The resulting ConvNeXt family reported 87.8% ImageNet top-1 accuracy and stronger COCO detection and ADE20K segmentation results than comparable Swin Transformers. BenchCouncil preserves the official work name as “ConvNeXts”, lists Zhuang Liu and Saining Xie as the contributor prefix, and associates the entry with Facebook and UC Berkeley in the United States.
description.zh:
在视觉 Transformer 成为主流视觉主干之后，ConvNeXt 重新审视了标准 ResNet。作者逐步引入现代训练方案、受 Transformer 启发的阶段设计、深度卷积、倒置瓶颈、更大卷积核、LayerNorm 和 GELU，同时让网络始终保持为纯卷积架构。

最终的 ConvNeXt 系列在 ImageNet 上报告 87.8% top-1 准确率，并在 COCO 检测与 ADE20K 分割上超过可比的 Swin Transformer。BenchCouncil 将官方成果名保留为“ConvNeXts”，把刘壮、谢赛宁列为人物前缀，并将该条目关联到美国的 Facebook 与加州大学伯克利分校。

text.en: Zhuang Liu and Saining Xie, the two main contributors named by BenchCouncil, are respectively the first and last authors of the CVPR 2022 paper, and both researcher-controlled homepages list ConvNeXt.
text.zh: BenchCouncil 列出的两位主要人物刘壮和谢赛宁分别是 CVPR 2022 论文的第一作者与末位作者，两人的个人主页也都列出 ConvNeXt。

text.en: ConvNeXt progressively modernizes a ResNet with a contemporary training recipe, transformer-inspired stage ratios and stem, depthwise convolution, inverted bottlenecks, larger kernels, LayerNorm and GELU while remaining a pure ConvNet.
text.zh: ConvNeXt 逐步以现代训练方案、受 Transformer 启发的阶段比例与 stem、深度卷积、倒置瓶颈、更大卷积核、LayerNorm 和 GELU 改造 ResNet，同时始终保持纯卷积结构。

text.en: The paper reports 87.8% ImageNet top-1 accuracy and stronger COCO detection and ADE20K segmentation results than comparable Swin Transformers.
text.zh: 论文报告 87.8% 的 ImageNet top-1 准确率，并在 COCO 检测与 ADE20K 分割上超过可比的 Swin Transformer。

html.en: By 2021, vision transformers had overtaken conventional ConvNets on major recognition benchmarks, while hierarchical models such as Swin restored several convolution-like priors to support detection and segmentation. ConvNeXt asked whether a carefully modernized pure ConvNet could recover competitive accuracy and scalability without relying on self-attention.
html.zh: 到 2021 年，视觉 Transformer 已在主要识别基准上超过传统卷积网络，而 Swin 等分层模型又重新引入若干类似卷积的先验，以支持检测与分割。ConvNeXt 追问：如果系统地现代化一个纯卷积网络，它能否在不依赖自注意力的情况下重新获得有竞争力的准确率与扩展能力。

html.en: The study starts from a ResNet and changes one design family at a time: the training recipe, stage compute ratios, patchify stem and downsampling, depthwise convolution, inverted bottlenecks, large kernels, LayerNorm and GELU. The final ConvNeXt blocks use only standard convolutional components, so the comparison separates the effect of modern design choices from the presence of attention itself.
html.zh: 研究从 ResNet 出发，依次改变一类设计：训练方案、阶段计算比例、patchify stem 与下采样、深度卷积、倒置瓶颈、大卷积核、LayerNorm 和 GELU。最终的 ConvNeXt 模块只使用标准卷积组件，因此这组比较把现代设计选择的作用与是否存在注意力机制区分开来。

html.en: Experts generally treat ConvNeXt as strong evidence that architecture comparisons depend heavily on training recipes and low-level design details, not as a simple return to older CNNs. Its lasting value is a clean, scalable pure-convolution baseline and an openly released implementation that lets later vision backbones be compared against a modernized ConvNet rather than an outdated ResNet recipe.
html.zh: 专家通常把 ConvNeXt 视为一项有力证据：架构比较在很大程度上取决于训练方案和底层设计细节，而不是简单回到旧式 CNN。它的长期价值在于提供了干净、可扩展的纯卷积基线和开放实现，使后续视觉主干可以与现代化卷积网络比较，而不是只与沿用旧训练方案的 ResNet 比较。
